description.html: With 189 liters of volume, this aquarium (90x30x70 cm) gives you freedom in aquascaping: larger roots, more plants, bigger stones and more fish. Glass of the right thickness keeps it safe under higher water pressure.

A large aquarium opens up the possibility of a biotope approach: recreating the natural habitat of the Amazon River, African lakes or Southeast Asia. We recommend an external filter, a CO2 system for plants and quality LED lighting.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
